propositions: LLM replies may contain schema-valid decoys alongside the intended JSON payload, causing extraction heuristics to select the wrong object or a fence-wrapped quoted variant
An explicit output channel using line-anchored sentinel markers (<<<REBAR_OUTPUT>>> and <<<END>>>) makes the payload location a stated contract, preventing decoy wins and fence-wrapping confusion

Extraction logic must iterate complete marker blocks in reverse document order (last-first) and apply schema validation to each; if none validates, raise the last block's error (fail-closed); if no complete blocks exist, fall back to the current full-reply selection pipeline unchanged
The bounded-retry prompt in structured_run.py must name the same markers as the first attempt to preserve the fail-closed channel consistency across both attempts

Marker pairing is deterministic and collision-proof: markers recognized only as line-anchored tokens (stripped line equals marker exactly); each opening marker pairs with the next closing marker; interleaved/repeated markers pair left-to-right, non-nested

Test coverage must verify marker extraction priority over schema-decoys, last-block-wins semantics, markerless fallback byte-for-byte equivalence, fail-closed behavior on invalid marker content, and live per-cell parse-success non-regression
